title: Project Intelligence Console Graph Freshness and Staleness Checks v0.1
objective: Extend Project Intelligence graph analysis to detect stale docs, missing cascades, orphan code entries, missing test links, and progress-state inconsistencies while preserving the local-only artifact boundary.
acceptance: Add deterministic staleness findings to local Project Intelligence snapshots.
Flag ADR/spec/docs cascade gaps, orphan implementation entries, missing test references, and inconsistent progress states.
Expose findings in the local static viewer without adding network, telemetry, upload, or hosted dashboard behavior.
Keep all generated outputs under ignored local artifact boundaries.
Update operations docs, testing strategy, acceptance checklist, decision log, dev log, and progress snapshot.
